tagline_en: Stop hand-rolling prompts. Grab battle-tested skills, drop them into Claude Code, and level up your dev flow.

why_en: Every skill ships with explicit scope and prerequisites, so you know it'll work before you even install it.

limit_en: Claude Code only; no other AI tools. Quality varies by community upkeep; cold skills may lag. Manual selection required—no bulk install.
